sources.claim: Kaspersky reports that Stuxnet Resource 207 contained a Flame platform component and that whole pieces of Flame module code matched the Resource 207 code.
Kaspersky's Gauss paper states that a first Stuxnet variant included a module created from the Flame platform, indicating collaboration between Flame and Stuxnet/Duqu platform teams.

curator_note: Modeled as code sharing rather than derivation because Kaspersky describes platform collaboration and source-code exchange, while also treating Flame and Stuxnet/Tilded as separate projects.
confidence_reason: Two Kaspersky publications provide direct reverse-engineering claims tying early Stuxnet Resource 207 to the Flame platform.
